events.text:
I ran the dry run against production. Output and PDF are real for all three test personas, but no email went out: Tantra refuses to create the Day 1 campaigns because team@growthclub.org isn't connected as a mailbox (T-123). T-034 is blocked on T-123 and T-400, with no new ask.

**COMPLETION CHECK**
- **Point the harness at the production centre with three test personas:** done in run 20261011-235507. I added a production mode to `workshop-plan/ops/dryrun_day1.py` that changes only two production settings for the run (delivery switched on, the three test addresses allowed) and puts them back afterwards. I checked afterwards: delivery is off again and the test-email list is back to [email]. The key was not copied anywhere.
- **Three personas processed with no manual step:** done for output and PDF. SendFlow, Apex Growth and Sarah Chen got their output pages and PDFs, and the harness opened each page and PDF link on production.
- **Create the Day N campaigns and import the three test contacts:** blocked on T-123. Tantra answered "team@growthclub.org isn't a connected mailbox in this Tantra workspace." I didn't switch to another workspace mailbox, because they belong to live client accounts.
- **Send the Day 1 test email:** blocked on T-123 for the same reason. Nothing was sent.
- **WhatsApp status:** Tantra reports one WhatsApp account connected, but T-400 has no test number yet. WhatsApp is marked "pending T-400" and was not sent to anyone.
- **Timings in runbook.md section 6:** done. Submit to PDF and link took 15.9 s, 20.9 s and 22.1 s. Delivery time can't be measured until email sends. A note under the table explains this.
- **Test rows tagged test afterwards:** done. All three read test=1 revoked=1.
- **Remove test contacts from the campaigns:** nothing to remove, because no campaign or contact was created.
- **Commit and push:** done. Commit 6bab8bbf is pushed to origin main without force; the coordination log had no "publish held".
- **Blocker:** the Orchestrator said T-400 only, but the run showed the email leg also needs T-123. I set the blockers to T-123 and T-400, since both already carry the asks.
- **Notes acknowledged:** F-23f53c5f and R-e81680b7.
- **Still to run:** `dryrun_day1.py --require-real`, once T-123 and T-400 land.
